content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMO Ghaziabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Chief Medical Office Ghaziabad (CMO Ghaziabad) under the National Health Mission (NHM) and related healthcare schemes in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies available for various Medical Officer posts across different departments, health centers, and schemes in Ghaziabad district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for CMO Ghaziabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date along with required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to take place on 15 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time with all necessary paperwork.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and must be duly registered with the Uttar Pradesh State Medical Council to be eligible for these Medical Officer positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised Medical Officer posts is 65 years. Candidates must check specific age requirements from the official notification if any relaxations apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 depending on the specific post, which includes honorarium and Performance Based Incentives (PBI) where applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application process is free of cost.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original educational certificates, MBBS degree, Uttar Pradesh State Medical Council registration certificate, valid ID proof, passport-size photographs, and self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for updates?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Ghaziabad district website at https://ghaziabad.nic.in to access the official notification details, updates, and further announcements regarding the recruitment process.
